name: ollama
note: Local inference — no key, no cost, no network egress. Requires Ollama running on the host.

name: huggingface
note: Free HuggingFace Inference API. Any HF account provides a free token at hf.co/settings/tokens.

name: mistral
note: Free tier on small models. Sign up at console.mistral.ai — no credit card required.
